product.name: School Trips
product.description: Daily transportation service for students of various age groups, providing safe and reliable rides to and from school.

product.name: Business Trips
product.description: Scheduled daily transportation for company employees, ensuring timely and comfortable rides to work and back.

product.name: University Trips
product.description: Transportation service tailored for university students, offering daily rides with features suited to their needs.

product.name: Travel Trips
product.description: Organized leisure and recreational trips for schools and businesses using buses equipped for travel comfort.

product.description: A mobile app that enables users to book rides, track buses live, monitor onboard cameras, and manage subscriptions.

product.name: Captain Driver Program
product.description: A program for drivers involving evaluation, scheduled trips, guaranteed timely payments, and performance monitoring.
